why: The quiet Rancho Coronado street corner where Kerry parks for the 'Rebel! Rebel!' meet-up; a Mallagra St sign stands on the corner, matching the wiki's Manzanita/Mallagra meeting point. The street, buildings, storefront door, food and drink tokens come from world streaming; the coffee-cart grouping, its counter workspots and the barista spawner come from the sq017 quest prefab. This proposal loads that one prefab and activates its single community entry, the counter barista, so the corner reads as a working coffee stand instead of an empty street. Nobody else belongs here: Kerry, his borrowed Galena, the Riot bouncer, the Us Cracks bodyguard and the freeway ambush all belong to scenes that never run or to other sq017 venues.

open_questions: Stand at the cart and check the barista is serving. Walk to (348.7,-1416.8) and confirm Character.sq017_filipino_barista is standing at the counter in the relaxed bar-lean, not missing, T-posed or crouched.

Check the cart, counter and cups read as a normal coffee stand. The coffee cups, sit/stand interaction entities and food tokens are always-streamed quest props; confirm they look like an ordinary cart and no invisible sit prompt appears at an empty counter.
Check the door beside the cart opens. The anchor door at (348.1,-1411.1) is a plain world single_door with no quest action; confirm it is powered and unlocked in normal play.
Check the corner appears once. Confirm the coffee cart, barista and storefront are not duplicated after the venue phase and the district stream have both run.
Check no sq017 scene leftovers are visible. Confirm there is no parked Galena, no Kerry, and no meeting-position marker or scene prop floating at the corner.

communities.why: The coffee cart's own barista, the only person vanilla places at this corner. Vanilla activates her when V waits for Kerry and leaves her at the counter; the workspot is a relaxed bar lean, so the same phase reads as a normal barista at work once no quest runs. needs_tour_check is set because the catalogue could not resolve her community area node (posture 'unknown') and the point of the tour item is to confirm she spawns at all.

proximity_wait.why: The storefront single door beside the coffee cart: a real DoorControllerPS entity (template base\gameplay\devices\doors\final\single_door.ent, appearance doors_single_kitsch_e) at (348.07,-1411.07,15.23), 5.8 m from the barista counter at (348.69,-1416.84,15.32), so a player at the cart satisfies the proximity wait. The catalogue lists no device for this venue and no anchor_candidates (the only device it lists is the Riot VIP lift door 5 km away), so the anchor was resolved from the venue's own world device prefab: node {single_door} in exterior_5_-23_0_0.streamingsector, nodeIdx 193, globalNodeId 6406209901714741464, which equals FNV-1a-64 of this path with '#' removed. It is a world door, not a quest-driven device, so the runtime door policy will not act on it.
